sources.licenceEvidence: server/data/LICENSE in the same repository is the CC0 1.0 Universal text; the repository README: sentence text in /server/data is released under CC0 (the Europarl-derived files are the stated exception; none is used here)
sources.attribution: not required (CC0); credited: Mozilla Common Voice contributors

licence: CC BY 2.0 FR (the Tatoeba part; the Common Voice part is CC0)
attribution: Tatoeba Project (https://tatoeba.org), CC BY 2.0 FR; Mozilla Common Voice sentence contributors (CC0)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang ta --script tamil --min-count 2 --stop 'டாம்,டோம்,மேரி,மேரியுடன்,மேரியை' --out ta_words.v2.txt tam_text.txt ta_sentence-collector.txt
inputPreparation: tam_text.txt = column 3 of tam_sentences.tsv (one sentence per line); the Common Voice files are used as downloaded

measurement.heldOut: 1 in 6 Common Voice sentences held out by SHA-256 of the sentence; lists built from Tatoeba + the other 5 in 6 with the same settings; share of held-out word tokens the list contains
measurement.note: the shipped list is built from ALL the sentences (it is larger than the measured one)

publishing: published beside the original ta_words.txt, which is unchanged: HarmoniKeyboard bundles and pins the original, and neither app adopts a new list without its own measurement
